hub.notes: Beep until confirmed: optional repeat of the turn chirp every ~2s until the turn is taken (either/or with the chirp-length slider, now up to 20x). The hub repeats for its own player turn and relays the mode to nodes.

node.notes: Silent presses everywhere, non-blocking tone sequencer, and the retuned per-button tones — the node half of the master merge.
